title: Spike: pi-durable on a DynamoDB Storage backend, driven per turn
description:
Throwaway spike (spikes/pi-durable-6c4d24/). Prove, with measurements, before any product code:
1. A DynamoDB implementation of pi-durable's Storage interface passes its storage conformance suite (registerStorageConformance), locally against DynamoDB Local.
2. One storage per bot conversation; a short-lived owner (simulating the turn Lambda) opens it, submits a user message with a requestId, runs a turn on OpenAI gpt-5-nano, commits, closes; a second owner reopens and continues.
3. Crash mid-turn (kill the owner during the model call and during a tool call); the next owner resumes unfinished tasks from checkpoints; idempotent requestId resubmission returns the original.
4. watchEvents()/commit operations mapped onto the one-turn stream (event kinds, sizes).
5. Another participant's message injected with attribution; a tool call gated (approval) and a tool executed remotely.
6. Later, in AWS (needs the human's go-ahead): cold start and bundle size of the owner in a Node 22 Lambda outside any VPC.
Results go into docs/PI_HARNESS.md.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Spike complete on branch claude/pi-durable-spike-6c4d24 (PR #391): review fixes (idempotent ClientRequestToken commits, OwnershipLost on fence loss with a stale owner that stops, best-effort cleanup) and the S3-plus-DynamoDB-index storage (23/23 conformance, all phase scripts incl. handoff pass on moto; index items <= 361 bytes; 410 KB entry and 4.2 MB commit now work). Open: real-AWS run (needs human go-ahead), snapshot object, orphan sweeper, defer-to-computer path, no-owner human messages, fewer commits per turn.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Triage 2026-10-14: closing as done; the spike's decision shipped. Evidence: results are in docs/PI_HARNESS.md (the real-AWS run with cold start and bundle measurements, lines ~351-368; conformance 23 of 23 for the production S3-plus-index storage in conversation/src/storage/indexed-storage.ts, run in CI), spike code in spikes/pi-durable-6c4d24/, PR 391. The production control plane runs on this harness and the handoff from a serverless worker to the computer owner is proven live on development (README 'The computer runs Pi on development', docs/PI_SESSION_HANDOFF.md). The spike's own open items (orphan sweeper, no-owner human messages, fewer commits per turn) are product backlog, not spike work.

right_now_summary: The spike is complete, with evidence documented and its decision shipped.
